description: 固定目录唯一3月锚点后使用剩余1次GET，同主机路径HTTP锚点规范到HTTPS并保存原锚；不自动重定向/重试，总请求3结束。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from urllib.parse import urlsplit,urlunsplit
import json,hashlib,time
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd();REL='reports/research/510300_electricity_physical_quantity_source_qualification_v1';OUT=ROOT/REL
assert not (OUT/'原公开收件_全部.json').exists(),'固定原对象收件已结束，不重复。'
obj=json.loads((OUT/'原公开收件_前两对象.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
links=json.loads((OUT/'目录中固定三月原文锚点.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert obj['raw_official_gets']==2 and obj['raw_get_budget_remaining']==1
assert len(links)==1,'没有唯一同3月原文锚点，停止不猜地址。'
anchor=links[0]
u=urlsplit(anchor['url']);assert u.hostname=='www.nea.gov.cn' and '/2024-04/17/' in u.path
requested=urlunsplit(('https',u.netloc,u.path,u.query,u.fragment))
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
r={'object_id':'national_electricity_2024_03','object_role':'固定全国3月单月原文',
 'anchor_url':anchor['url'],'url':requested,'scheme_normalization':'同主机/路径HTTP锚点以HTTPS请求，非重试或换源',
 'catalogue_raw_sha256':anchor['catalogue_raw_sha256'],'requested_at':now(),
 'method':'GET','authenticated':False,'redirects_enabled':False,'attempt':1}
s=requests.Session();s.trust_env=False;t0=time.monotonic()
try:
 resp=s.get(requested,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Accept':'text/html'},timeout=(10,25),allow_redirects=False)
 data=resp.content;p=OUT/'raw/national_electricity_2024_03.html';p.write_bytes(data)
 r.update({'received_at':now(),'http_status':resp.status_code,'response_url':resp.url,
   'content_type':resp.headers.get('Content-Type'),'response_date':resp.headers.get('Date'),
   'raw_path':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'bytes':len(data),
   'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'status':'RAW_RESPONSE_SAVED' if resp.status_code==200 else 'HTTP_NON200_SAVED',
   'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-t0,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False})
except Exception as e:
 r.update({'received_at':now(),'status':'REQUEST_FAILED_NO_RETRY','error_type':type(e).__name__,'error':str(e),'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-t0})
finally:s.close()
obj['receipts'].append(r);obj['raw_official_gets']=3;obj['raw_get_budget_remaining']=0
obj['recorded_at']=now();obj['all_source_requests_finished']=True;obj['live_process']=False
(OUT/'原公开收件_全部.json').write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False))
for item in obj['receipts']:
 if item['object_id']=='official_news_catalogue' or item.get('http_status')!=200:continue
 soup=BeautifulSoup((ROOT/item['raw_path']).read_bytes(),'html.parser')
 for n in soup.find_all(['script','style']):n.decompose()
 print('\n实际原文',item['object_id'],soup.get_text(' ',strip=True))
